\[ \text{Frequency (MHz)} = \frac{\text{Coupling Constant (Hz)}}{\text{Distance between peaks (ppm)}} \]

\[
\text{Frequency (MHz)} = \frac{7 \text{ Hz}}{0.014 \text{ ppm}}
\]
